title: OPERATOR-UX — Posting time reminders (noon + evening Telegram crons)
description: Gate urgency: 0/30 posts, 22 days to Apr 7. Add two PM2 crons that send Telegram reminders to post a video — once at noon, once at 7pm. Each message includes how many posts remain to hit the gate. Creates scripts/remind-post.ts.

tasks.title: Create scripts/remind-post.ts — posting reminder with gate status
tasks.description: Read workspace/gates/phase1-5-gate.json (current_posts, target_posts, deadline). Compute posts_remaining = target - current. If current >= target, skip silently (gate met). Send Telegram message: '⏰ Posting reminder — N videos needed by DEADLINE. Post one now!' Use https.request (TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN + OWNER_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID). Max 60 lines.

tasks.title: Add two PM2 cron entries: noon + 7pm reminder
tasks.description: Add scs001-remind-noon (cron: '0 12 * * *') and scs001-remind-evening (cron: '0 19 * * *'). Both run scripts/remind-post.ts. autorestart: false, watch: false.
